validations.title: Boisson borne -> cuisine: BOISSON: Hawai 33cl + KDS card
validations.evidence: Kitchen ESC/POS decoded from GET /api/frontend/order/show/{id}/escpos?ticket=kitchen (HTTP 200). Formule order #5537 renders exactly '** BOISSON: Hawai 33cl' (extractFormuleDrinkLines, KitchenTicketSymbolicFormatter:321). Standalone order #5547 renders '1 x Hawai 33cl' full name (OrderReceiptEscPosRenderer:303) - fix confirmed: no cryptic 'HAW', no 'Fanta Hawai'. Root fix isDrinkItem (KitchenTicketSymbolicFormatter:277-307) matches hawa[iï] + volumetric 33cl. KDS card = JS twin kdsCustomization.js:50 DRINK_NAME_RE includes hawa[iï] + :51 DRINK_VOLUME_RE 33cl (same regex), order #5547/#5550 status=4 board-released -> appears on KDS with drink categorized.

validations.title: Ticket serveur/caisse: A REGLER EN CAISSE gras, 0 ligne paiement, 32 col
validations.evidence: GET /api/frontend/order/show/5547/escpos?ticket=client HTTP 200 (endpoint fires, orderId in URL). Decoded bytes: '** A REGLER EN CAISSE **' present and BOLD (preceding bytes 1B 61 01 1B 45 01 = ESC center + ESC E bold ON). ZERO payment/settlement lines (no PAIEMENT / Especes / Carte / Rendu / Recu); totals block ends A REGLER TTC 8,80 then A REGLER EN CAISSE. MAXW=32 (all lines <= 32 columns, 58mm width-safe).

validations.title: Synchro dispo refcount (fd6193215) + Hawai naming
validations.evidence: Refcount fix proven by eventContractChannelRefcount.spec.js (8/8 green): two subscribers on branch.1 share ONE Echo channel; first (waiting screen) unsubscribe does NOT leave and keeps shell listeners; last unsubscribe leaves once; double-unsubscribe idempotent; re-subscribe rebuilds. Wiring confirmed in real components: KioskAppComponent.vue (onEvents:546 / _eventSub.unsubscribe:815) and KioskWaitingComponent.vue (onEvents:272 / _eventSub.unsubscribe:303) both use the refcounted eventContract - NO raw Echo.leave anywhere -> unmounting the waiting screen cannot kill the shell's branch.1 availability subscription. Naming: DOM drinks category shows 'Hawai 33cl' (item 124), hawaiRaw=['Hawai'], 0 'Fanta Hawai' in DOM; 0 DB items 'Fanta Hawa'; only a seeder comment documents the rename.

environmental_observations.note: STAFF_ONLY_MODE=true + a persistent authenticated staff POS session in the shared browser bounces the kiosk to /admin/pos on order composition (staff-landing). Real borne runs on a machine token (never staff-authed), so this is expected product behaviour, but it blocked pure UI-driven order completion; transactional attestation done via the borne's real backend contract (kiosk:order token API + DB + escpos endpoint = SSOT). Not a borne code defect.

1 console error on /kiosk/idle: 403 @ /api/broadcasting/auth (kiosk private-channel websocket auth not wired in this local env). Independent of the refcount fix (client-side channel bookkeeping, proven by unit tests + component wiring). Verify Reverb/Pusher broadcasting auth before prod for live availability push.
Shared Playwright browser is co-driven by parallel Wave-2 surface agents (KDS/caisse on tab 0); worked around by using a dedicated kiosk tab.
